summary: Apollo Infrastructure Company LLC filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 on September 30, 2026, declaring ordinary quarterly cash distributions across its Series I and Series II share classes. Per-share amounts range from $0.2143 to $0.2237 for Series I and $0.2222 to $0.2315 for Series II, payable to holders of record as of September 30, 2026, with payment on or about October 26, 2026. Shareholders may receive cash or reinvest via the distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation event, deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed.
